name: coverage-map-churn-128
scope: One actual checked NR_Request, passed unchanged to both complete maintained backends. Hosted diagnostic clocks include rendering and file writes, exclude machine construction and process teardown. No native speed or generated-execution claim.
verdict:
ALL PROOFS CHECK
Use --verdict for mathematical validity.

c.units: work: executed named JS entries or explicit nonempty-row visits; objects: literal tagged-object construction-site events, not native allocation calls/bytes or retained objects
c.producerScope: Tuple/WCon labels name the generated function containing the literal construction site, including its nested closures; not dynamic caller/stack attribution.
c.scope: Adjacent first-entry intervals partition this observed backend clock. They include descendant, continuation, observer, IO and GC work. No inclusive function-duration claim.
